first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The visible portion of a black-gray long gun extending into the frame from the bottom edge, with a raised front sight and a repeated toothed upper contour.

entities.name: damp, debris-strewn corridor floor
entities.identification: The dark floor leading toward the far entrance between the walls on both sides, with reflective standing water and light-colored debris distributed across it.

entities.name: peeling two-tone corridor wall
entities.identification: The corridor walls, lighter on the upper portions and dark gray-green on the lower portions, with irregular peeling, on both sides of the corridor.

entities.name: open doorway at the far end of the corridor
entities.identification: The rectangular entrance at the far end of the corridor, with a dark door panel on the left and an opening on the right revealing a brighter space behind it.

entities.name: square wall light at the far end
entities.identification: The small bright white wall light above and to the left of the far entrance, currently appearing as a short rectangular illuminated surface.

entities.name: dark panel cabinet leaning diagonally against the right wall
entities.identification: The tall, dark, framed panel-like object leaning diagonally beside the right wall, with lighter partitioned surfaces inside.

entities.name: damaged suspended ceiling
entities.identification: The ceiling structure above the corridor, with missing panels, exposed framing, and light-colored panel pieces bent and hanging downward.

entities.name: exposed corridor piping
entities.identification: The long pipes of varying thickness extending along the upper right side of the corridor, with an additional light-colored vertical pipe that bends at the right edge in the first frame.

entities.name: hanging corridor cables
entities.identification: The thin black hanging lines near the opening in the suspended ceiling, and the cables sagging in arcs along the upper portion of the right wall.

entities.name: scattered corridor debris
entities.identification: The light-gray broken panels, long narrow strips, irregular fragments, and fine debris distributed in patches across the floor.

entities.name: standing water on the corridor floor
entities.identification: The irregular areas of standing water on the floor that are dark and have intermittent bright reflections.
